verses.zh: 那时，利未人的众族长来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长面前，
verses.en: The tribal leaders of the Levites went before Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and the Israelite tribal leaders

verses.zh: 在迦南地的示罗对他们说：「从前耶和华藉着摩西吩咐给我们城邑居住，并城邑的郊野可以牧养我们的牲畜。」
verses.en: in Shiloh in the land of Canaan and said, “The Lord told Moses to assign us cities in which to live along with the grazing areas for our cattle.”

verses.zh: 于是以色列人照耶和华所吩咐的，从自己的地业中，将以下所记的城邑和城邑的郊野给了利未人。
verses.en: So the Israelites assigned these cities and their grazing areas to the Levites from their own holdings, as the Lord had instructed.

verses.zh: 为哥辖族拈阄：利未人的祭司、亚伦的子孙，从犹大支派、西缅支派、便雅悯支派的地业中，按阄得了十三座城。
verses.en: The first lot belonged to[NOTE:1] the Kohathite clans. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest were allotted 13 cities from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

verses.zh: 哥辖其余的子孙，从以法莲支派、但支派、玛拿西半支派的地业中，按阄得了十座城。
verses.en: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted 10 cities from the clans of the tribe of Ephraim, and from the tribe of Dan and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.zh: 革顺的子孙，从以萨迦支派、亚设支派、拿弗他利支派、住巴珊的玛拿西半支派的地业中，按阄得了十三座城。
verses.en: Gershon’s descendants were allotted 13 cities from the clans of the tribe of Issachar, and from the tribes of Asher and Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

verses.zh: 米拉利的子孙，按着宗族，从流便支派、迦得支派、西布伦支派的地业中，按阄得了十二座城。
verses.en: Merari’s descendants by their clans were allotted 12 cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

verses.zh: 以色列人照着耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的，将这些城邑和城邑的郊野，按阄分给利未人。
verses.en: So the Israelites assigned to the Levites by lot these cities and their grazing areas, as the Lord had instructed Moses.

verses.zh: 从犹大支派、西缅支派的地业中，将以下所记的城给了利未支派哥辖宗族亚伦的子孙；因为给他们拈出头一阄，
verses.en: They assigned from the tribes of Judah and Simeon the cities listed below.

verses.zh: a
verses.en: (They were assigned to the Kohathite clans of the Levites who were descendants of Aaron,[NOTE:1] for the first lot fell to them.)
notes: Heb “and it belonged to the sons of Aaron, from the Kohathite clans, from the sons of Levi.”

verses.zh: 将犹大山地的基列・亚巴和四围的郊野给了他们。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖。（基列・亚巴就是希伯仑）。
verses.en: They assigned them Kiriath Arba (Arba was the father of Anak), that is, Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, along with its surrounding grazing areas.

verses.zh: 惟将属城的田地和村庄给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒为业。
verses.en: (Now the city’s fields and surrounding towns they had assigned to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his property.)

verses.zh: 以色列人将希伯仑，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了祭司亚伦的子孙；又给他们立拿和属城的郊野，
verses.en: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they assigned Hebron (a city of refuge for one who committed manslaughter), Libnah,

verses.zh: 雅提珥和属城的郊野，以实提莫和属城的郊野，
verses.en: Jattir, Eshtemoa,

verses.zh: 何仑和属城的郊野，底璧和属城的郊野，
verses.en: Holon, Debir,

verses.zh: 亚因和属城的郊野，淤他和属城的郊野，伯・示麦和属城的郊野，共九座城，都是从这二支派中分出来的。
verses.en: Ain, Juttah, and Beth Shemesh, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of nine cities taken from these two tribes.

verses.zh: 又从便雅悯支派的地业中给了他们基遍和属城的郊野，迦巴和属城的郊野，
verses.en: From the tribe of Benjamin they assigned[NOTE:1] Gibeon, Geba,
notes: The words “they assigned” are supplied for clarification (also in vv. 23, 25).

verses.zh: 亚拿突和属城的郊野，亚勒们和属城的郊野，共四座城。
verses.en: Anathoth, and Almon, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of four cities.

verses.zh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的共有十三座城，还有属城的郊野。
verses.en: The priests descended from Aaron received 13 cities and their grazing areas.

verses.zh: 利未支派中哥辖的宗族，就是哥辖其余的子孙，拈阄所得的城有从以法莲支派中分出来的。
verses.en: The rest of the Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted cities from the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.zh: 以色列人将以法莲山地的示剑，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们基色和属城的郊野，
verses.en: They assigned them Shechem (a city of refuge for one who committed manslaughter) in the hill country of Ephraim, Gezer,

verses.zh: 基伯先和属城的郊野，伯・和仑和属城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.en: Kibzaim, and Beth Horon, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of four cities.

verses.zh: 又从但支派的地业中给了他们伊利提基和属城的郊野，基比顿和属城的郊野，
verses.en: From the tribe of Dan they assigned Eltekeh, Gibbethon,

verses.zh: 亚雅仑和属城的郊野，迦特・临门和属城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.en: Aijalon, and Gath Rimmon, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of four cities.

verses.zh: 又从玛拿西半支派的地业中给了他们他纳和属城的郊野，迦特・临门和属城的郊野，共两座城。
verses.en: From the half-tribe of Manasseh they assigned Taanach and Gath Rimmon,[NOTE:1] along with the grazing areas of each—a total of two cities.
notes: The name “Gath Rimmon” is problematic here, for it appears in the preceding list of Danite cities. The LXX reads Iebatha (Ιεβαθα); 1 Chr 6:55 HT (6:70 ET) reads Bilʿam (בִּלְעָם). Most modern translations retain the name “Gath Rimmon,” however.

verses.zh: 哥辖其余的子孙共有十座城，还有属城的郊野。
verses.en: The rest of the Kohathite clans received 10 cities and their grazing areas.

verses.zh: 以色列人又从玛拿西半支派的地业中将巴珊的哥兰，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了利未支派革顺的子孙；又给他们比・施提拉和属城的郊野，共两座城；
verses.en: They assigned to the Gershonite clans of the Levites the following cities:[NOTE:1] from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan (a city of refuge for one who committed manslaughter) and Beeshtarah, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of two cities;
notes: The words “they assigned” and “the following cities” are supplied for clarification (also in v. 34).

verses.zh: 又从以萨迦支派的地业中给了他们基善和属城的郊野，大比拉和属城的郊野，
verses.en: from the tribe of Issachar: Kishon, Daberath,

verses.zh: 耶末和属城的郊野，隐・干宁和属城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.en: Jarmuth, and En Gannim, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of four cities;

verses.zh: 又从亚设支派的地业中给了他们米沙勒和属城的郊野，押顿和属城的郊野，
verses.en: from the tribe of Asher: Mishal, Abdon,

verses.zh: 黑甲和属城的郊野，利合和属城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.en: Helkath, and Rehob, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of four cities;

verses.zh: 又从拿弗他利支派的地业中将加利利的基低斯，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们哈末・多珥和属城的郊野，加珥坦和属城的郊野，共三座城。
verses.en: from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee (a city of refuge for one who committed manslaughter), Hammoth Dor, and Kartan, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of three cities.

verses.zh: 革顺人按着宗族所得的城，共十三座，还有属城的郊野。
verses.en: The Gershonite clans received 13 cities and their grazing areas.

verses.zh: 其余利未支派米拉利子孙，从西布伦支派的地业中所得的，就是约念和属城的郊野，加珥他和属城的郊野，
verses.en: They assigned to the Merarite clans (the remaining Levites) the following cities: from the tribe of Zebulun: Jokneam, Kartah,

verses.zh: 丁拿和属城的郊野，拿哈拉和属城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.en: Dimnah, and Nahalal, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of four cities;

verses.zh: 又从流便支派的地业中给了他们比悉和属城的郊野，雅杂和属城的郊野，
verses.en: [NOTE:1] from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer, Jahaz,
notes: 21:36-37 are accidentally omitted from a number of significant Hebrew mss. They are, however, found in some Hebrew mss, the LXX and Vulgate.

verses.zh: 基底莫和属城的郊野，米法押和属城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.en: Kedemoth, and Mephaath, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of four cities;

verses.zh: 又从迦得支派的地业中，将基列的拉末，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们玛哈念和属城的郊野，
verses.en: from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead (a city of refuge for one who committed manslaughter), Mahanaim,

verses.zh: 希实本和属城的郊野，雅谢和属城的郊野，共四座城。
verses.en: Heshbon, and Jazer, along with the grazing areas of each—a total of four cities.

verses.zh: 其余利未支派的人，就是米拉利的子孙，按着宗族拈阄所得的，共十二座城。
verses.en: The Merarite clans (the remaining Levites) were allotted 12 cities.

verses.zh: 利未人在以色列人的地业中所得的城，共四十八座，并有属城的郊野。
verses.en: The Levites received within the land owned by the Israelites[NOTE:1] 48 cities in all and their grazing areas.
notes: Heb “in the midst of the possession of the sons of Israel.”

verses.zh: 这些城四围都有属城的郊野，城城都是如此。
verses.en: Each of these cities had grazing areas around it; they were alike in this regard.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “these cities were city [by] city, and its grazing areas [were] around it; so [it was] for all these cities.”

verses.zh: 这样，耶和华将从前向他们列祖起誓所应许的全地赐给以色列人，他们就得了为业，住在其中。
verses.en: So the Lord gave Israel all the land he had solemnly promised to their ancestors,[NOTE:1] and they conquered[NOTE:2] it and lived in it.
notes: Heb “which he had sworn to give to their fathers.”

verses.zh: 耶和华照着向他们列祖起誓所应许的一切话，使他们四境平安；他们一切仇敌中，没有一人在他们面前站立得住。耶和华把一切仇敌都交在他们手中。
verses.en: The Lord made them secure,[NOTE:1] in fulfillment of all he had solemnly promised their ancestors.[NOTE:2] None of their enemies could resist them.[NOTE:3] The Lord handed all their enemies over to them.[NOTE:4]
notes: Heb “according to all he swore to their fathers.”
Heb “not a man stood from before them from all their enemies.”
Heb All their enemies the Lord gave into their hand.

verses.zh: 耶和华应许赐福给以色列家的话一句也没有落空，都应验了。
verses.en: Not one of the Lord’s faithful promises to the family of Israel[NOTE:1] was left unfulfilled; every one was realized.[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “the house of Israel.” Cf. NCV “the Israelites”; TEV “the people of Israel”; CEV, NLT “Israel.”
Heb “not a word from all the good word which the Lord spoke to the house of Israel fell; the whole came to pass.”
